claim: Match_prev asks this shot's cut to land on something the previous shot already established - the same composition, the same gesture mid-flight, the same eyeline, the same light. It is how a cut feels authored rather than merely next.
not_visual: Every value describes a relationship to a different shot. One still has no previous frame to match, so nothing in the panel can express the option; you would need a two-panel pair, which breaks the one-render-per-option method.
